items.metric: Margin hit from annual wage increments
items.quote: Samir Seksaria: On the wage increments, you should expect a similar impact on what we have seen in the past annual increment cycle, which had been in the range of 150 to 200 basis points.
items.why: The Q1 increments took 170 basis points off the margin, inside the range; margin then held at 24% in Q2.
items.actual_quote: In Q1, we rolled out annual increments for our global workforce, which impacted margins by 170 bps .

note: TCS does not give numeric revenue or margin guidance, so only this cost item can be checked.
